name: Founder Operator mission-to-artifact orchestration
acceptanceCriteria: A founder-only Control Room surface converts one mission into a durable plan with ULTRATHINK orientation, explicit artifact ownership, evidence paths, and a founder decision gate.
Fixed-path persistence rejects private or credential-shaped content and accepts local-evidence only when the server itself can attest a passed allowlisted verification mission.
Founder approval remains distinct from executed verification, and approval-gated external actions stay human-required until separately completed.

verification.evidence: Local focused evidence on July 24, 2026: 10/10 core and Founder Operator persistence tests passed; exact-head repository and browser access-control checks remain required before merge.
